feeds.title: Die or D.I.Y.?
feeds.description: Die or D.I.Y.? is a blog that covers the taste of obscure music. Jonny Zchivago is the author behind the blog, he has multiple blogs, and this particular blog is focused on obscure music. He is from London and is an art guy.

feeds.title: Soundaboard
feeds.description: Soundaboard has been sharing great quality unreleased recordings since 2007. AttickRock is a blogger whose favorite topic to write about is Rock and this is what this blog is all about.

feeds.title: Excavated Shellac
feeds.description: Excavated Shellac is a website dedicated to 78rpm recordings of folkloric and vernacular music from around the world. These items are from the author's collection (unless noted) and have been transferred to the best of his abilities, without the aid of expensive noise reduction software. They are for research purposes only. With just a few rare exceptions, he posts items that are not available on CD in any way, shape, or form.

feeds.title: Big 10-Inch Record
feeds.description: 10-inch LPs and other records from the early LP era

feeds.title: Blissblog
feeds.description: Simon Reynolds is the man who writes the Blissblog. This blog covers music at length, band/singer interviews, and more.

feeds.title: Madrotter Treasure Hunt
feeds.description: I am a Dutch expat living in Indonesia since 1996. I am a Music lover and crate-digger. I post music here to show my love and appreciation for the music I post. I post mostly about Indonesian music, occasionally some worth mentioning music is also discussed.

feeds.title: Noise Not Music
feeds.description: Welcome to Noise Not Music. Here you'll find reviews of recent albums, various features and lists, and occasional mixes. I tend to focus on material that resides in the experimental or avant-garde realm of music, but nothing is off-limits.

feeds.title: Dead Wax
feeds.description: The dead wax blog covers the music scene from the 80s. Bob writes about music, artists, and more.

feeds.title: Brace for the Obscure
feeds.description: Here you will find the greatest songs of the 1960's that no one has ever heard. I'm a man of wealth and taste. It is coming up on the 20th anniversary of the start of my still ongoing quest to listen to every pop/rock/soul song released or recorded in the 'Sixties'.

feeds.title: Obscure Sound
feeds.description: Obscure Sound is an indie music site that I formed in February 2006 out of a love for finding new and emerging quality music. My name is Mike Mineo and I'm the site's founder and editor. This site aims to provide music fans with the latest and greatest music, preferably from artists you've never heard of before.

feeds.title: The Wonderful and the Obscure
feeds.description: A look at some of the more remarkable items found during 40 years of collecting all manner of recordings. I'm the father of two amazing young adults, married to the most wonderful woman in the world, and I work in the mental health field. I play several instruments and record my music. I'm a long-time record collector, and hoarder of unusual, rare, or unique recorded sound, musical, spoken word, or other, and am glad to have found this outlet to share some of my favorite parts of it with others.

feeds.title: No Longer Forgotten Music
feeds.description: This blog is about music that lies in cellars, dug out by a group of people who care about great music. We share this music for free as a labor of love and because we want to share forgotten tunes of the past.

feeds.title: Unearthed In The Atomic Attic
feeds.description: My blogs are all about sharing obscure and sometimes odd recordings. My three blogs feature introductions to vintage & unique gospel recordings, atomic age pop, and lounge/strange music. I post only sample tracks from LPs and not entire albums. What I have to share is offered here.

feeds.title: Music You (Possibly) Won't Hear Anyplace Else
feeds.description: Music You (Possibly) Won't Hear Anyplace Else is a blog by Lee Hartsfeld. He was born in Toledo and served in the Navy for eight years. His interests are records (shellac and vinyl), sheet music, hymnals, gospel songbooks, plastic dinosaur toys, Godzilla collectibles, and other stuff. This blog is about obscure music.

feeds.title: I Am the Noize In Your Head
feeds.description: I am Poppacool, I collect records. I intend for my blogs to celebrate my record collection and the music I love and not to infringe on any rights of artists or record companies.

feeds.title: Systems of Romance Blog
feeds.description: Systems of Romance

feeds.title: Ezhevika Fields
feeds.description: Here, at Ezhevika Fields, I'm providing information & listening preview samples of lost albums from the past. My only aim is to promote real art & music for some reasons currently unavailable according to my sources.

feeds.title: Wilfully Obscure
feeds.description: Wilfully Obscure covers music, pop, punk, emo, indie rock, and shoegazer.

feeds.title: Darcy's Feel It
feeds.description: Darcy documents his love for music through his blog Darcy's Feel It. He calls himself a music nut, his favorite genres are Soul, Funk, Reggae, Blues, Jazz, and the rest!

feeds.title: Rising Storm
feeds.description: Rising Storm is a vintage music feed with original album reviews, sample mp3s, and video links. We mostly cover the mid-60s thru the early-80s in the genres of classic rock, country rock, psychedelic, and garage.

feeds.title: Rare And Obscure Music
feeds.description: Music you've never hear til now! A blog of rare, hardly-heard or remembered pop, hip-hop, R&B, freestyle, dance and country music from the '70s to the 2000s. From one-hit wonders to no-hit wonders, this blog has it all!!

feeds.title: Archaic Inventions
feeds.description: Archaic Inventions hopes to save obscure material, share this content with others, and mostly hope to inspire creative and urgent musical and artistic tendencies and their practices in the present.

feeds.title: White Doo-Wop Collector
feeds.description: In this blog, you will find single artists with groups, acetates, The 45's, who they are, group history, rival years, and more.

feeds.title: Artyfacts in Wax
feeds.description: My blog is a humble attempt to remember and learn more about many groups recorded on small or regional record labels. I post what information I have found from books and other various places. The recordings from the 45s are not professionally done, but they do showcase how talented they were.

feeds.title: The Devil's Music
feeds.description: An eclectic mixed bag of vinyl tricks & treats for your ears, eyes, & mind...

feeds.title: That's All Rite Mama
feeds.description: That's All Rite Mama is a music blog that covers the scene of music profoundly. Read about music and artists.

feeds.title: Rare and Obscure Music
feeds.description: Music you've never til now! A blog of rare, hardly-heard or remembered pop, hip-hop, R&B, freestyle, dance and country music from the '70s to the 2000s. From one-hit wonders to no-hit wonders, this blog has it all!!

feeds.title: Roots And Traces: Spurensicherung
feeds.description: Roots And Traces: Spurensicherung gives you a taste of obscure music. Read articles that describe what music was like in the millennial era.
